newsitem.title: USA: Access Beyond stake lifted by Cramer.
newsitem.headline: Access Beyond stake lifted by Cramer.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Tuesday it raised its stake in Access Beyond Inc to 2,697,300 common shares or 22.5 percent from 20.9 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 194,200 common shares between February 27 and March 14 at prices ranging from $4.9722 to $6 per share.
Access Beyond is a Gaithersburg, Md., maker of remote access products. The company was formerly part of Penril DataComm Networks.
